summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the detailed packet of an index becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: Whether Pocketful streams indices with the detailed layout, and with what in the trade fields, needs a live check.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Pocketful web adapter's frames carry its own. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds; the web passes the seconds on as ltt (1762656900), the desktop sends epoch milliseconds (1762656900000), the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.

The desktop sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent for an index; price_change is not a docs key and the Pocketful web adapter sends none, so it goes (lead ruling 2026-11-09). Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

An index has no trades, average price, book totals or open interest: Pocketful's index packet fills them with zeros, which the web passes on; the desktop's index frame leaves them out.
